title: FAB appoints Futoon Hamdan Almazrouei as Deputy Group CEO and CEO, Domestic Banking
summary: The appointment brings FAB’s domestic businesses and key capabilities under an expanded mandate

contentHtml:
Futoon Hamdan Almazrouei as Deputy Group Chief Executive Officer and CEO, Domestic Banking, First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB). Image courtesy: First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB)

The appointment brings FAB’s domestic businesses and key capabilities under an expanded mandate

Press Release

Abu Dhabi, First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB), the UAE’s global bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions, today announced the appointment of Futoon Hamdan Almazrouei as Deputy Group Chief Executive Officer and CEO, Domestic Banking, as the Bank advances its next phase of growth.

The appointment brings FAB’s domestic businesses and key capabilities under an expanded mandate, strengthening alignment, accountability and execution across the franchise.

Futoon is an experienced banking executive who has served as Group Head of Personal, Business, Wealth and Privileged Client Banking Group at FAB. Since joining the Bank in 2008, she has held several senior leadership roles, including Group Head of Consumer Banking, and has played a key role in advancing FAB’s digital transformation, and strengthening its retail and wealth banking franchise.

 About First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB)

Headquartered in Abu Dhabi with a global footprint beyond 20 markets, FAB is the finance and trade gateway to the Middle East and North Africa region (MENA). With total assets of AED 1.47 trillion (USD 401 billion) as of September-end 2026, FAB is among the world’s largest banking groups. The bank provides financial expertise to its wholesale and retail client franchise across three business units, including Investment Banking & Markets, Wholesale Banking, and Personal, Business, Wealth & Privileged Client Banking Group. 

FAB is listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX) and rated Aa3/AA-/AA- by Moody’s, S&P, and Fitch, respectively, with a stable outlook. FAB was also ranked first in TIME and Statista’s Arabia’s Top Companies of 2026 list, recognising its position among the region’s leading businesses. On sustainability, FAB holds an MSCI ESG rating of ‘AA’, ranks first among MENA banks and is within the top tier of global banks according to LSEG ESG Scores (formerly Refinitiv ESG Scores). FAB is also rated in the best Sustainalytics ESG Risk Rating category among global banks, with a Low ESG Risk.
